definitions.explanation: A woman on her wedding day or who has recently been married.

examples.japanese: {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The bride was wearing a beautiful dress.

examples.japanese: {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いて→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She was radiant in her bridal appearance.

examples.japanese: {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎた→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧。

⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{花嫁|はなよめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{白無垢|しろむく}→白無垢：27472_shiromuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ていて→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At my friend's wedding, I was moved by the bride wearing a traditional white kimono.
examples.notes: ⟦{白無垢|しろむく}→白無垢：27472_shiromuku⟧ = all-white bridal kimono

examples.japanese: {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{花婿|はなむこ}→花婿：21346_hanamuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つないで→繋ぐ：01962_tsunagu⟧⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦くると→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{参列者|さんれつしゃ}→参列者：28435_sanretsusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦フラワーシャワー→フラワーシャワー：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祝福|しゅくふく}→祝福：13733_shukufuku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the bride and groom came out of the church hand in hand, the guests celebrated with a flower shower.

notes:
USAGE: {花嫁|はなよめ} combines ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) and ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧ (bride/wife). It specifically refers to a woman in the context of her wedding.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a bride)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (bridal appearance)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧ (bridal attire)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧ (bridal training - learning domestic skills)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (bride's household items/trousseau)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧ (bridal procession)

CONTRAST:
- {花嫁|はなよめ} - bride
- ⟦{花婿|はなむこ}→花婿：21346_hanamuko⟧ - groom
